tests.title: A [sandbox] section without lease_timeout and reap_interval validates to 5m and 10m defaults
given: a minimal valid sandbox.Config with no lease_timeout and no reap_interval
tests.when: Validate is called on the config
then: the error is nil
Validated.LeaseTimeout equals 5*time.Minute
Validated.ReapInterval equals 10*time.Minute
tests.pseudocode: v, err = Validate(cfg); assert err == nil; assert v.LeaseTimeout == 5*time.Minute; assert v.ReapInterval == 10*time.Minute

tests.title: Valid lease_timeout and reap_interval values, including every boundary, are decoded and never reported as unknown keys
given: a TOML file with max_ttl = 1h and a [sandbox] section
tests.when: LoadConfig and Validate run for the pairs (1s,10s), (max_ttl,1h) and (90s,30s)
then: LoadConfig reports no unknown key for either name
Validate returns a nil error
the parsed time.Duration values equal the strings written
tests.pseudocode: for (lt, ri) in [(1s,10s),(1h,1h),(90s,30s)]: cfg = LoadConfig(write(lt, ri)); v, err = Validate(cfg); assert err == nil; assert v.LeaseTimeout == parse(lt); assert v.ReapInterval == parse(ri)

tests.title: An unparseable or out-of-range lease_timeout is reported by key together with every other [sandbox] failure
given: a config that also has a second invalid key, for example an unknown runtime
max_ttl = 1h
tests.when: Validate is called with lease_timeout set to "abc", "999ms" and "2h" in turn
then: each call returns a non-nil error
each error text contains "sandbox.lease_timeout"
each error text also contains the other collected failure
tests.pseudocode: for bad in ['abc','999ms','2h']: _, err = Validate(cfg(lease_timeout=bad, runtime='bogus')); assert err != nil; assert 'sandbox.lease_timeout' in err.Error(); assert 'sandbox.runtime' in err.Error()

tests.title: An unparseable or out-of-range reap_interval is reported by key together with every other [sandbox] failure
given: a config that also has a second invalid key
tests.when: Validate is called with reap_interval set to "xyz", "9s" and "61m" in turn
then: each call returns a non-nil error
each error text contains "sandbox.reap_interval"
each error text also contains the other collected failure
tests.pseudocode: for bad in ['xyz','9s','61m']: _, err = Validate(cfg(reap_interval=bad, runtime='bogus')); assert err != nil; assert 'sandbox.reap_interval' in err.Error(); assert 'sandbox.runtime' in err.Error()

tests.title: A configuration file without a [sandbox] section reads neither key and leaves the feature disabled
given: a config file with no [sandbox] section
tests.when: sandboxes.Init is called on that path
then: the returned service is nil
the returned error is nil
tests.pseudocode: svc, err = Init(logger, path, factory); assert svc == nil; assert err == nil

tests.title: POST stores lease_expires_at as the earlier of created_at + lease_timeout and expires_at
given: an in-memory SQLite database with the lease schema and migration
an injected clock
lease_timeout 5m
tests.when: a lease is created with ttl 1h and another with ttl 2m through POST /workspaces/:slug/sandboxes
then: both answer 201
the first body's lease_expires_at equals FormatUTC(created_at+5m)
the second body's lease_expires_at equals its expires_at (created_at+2m)
the stored column value equals the body value
tests.pseudocode: r1 = post(ttl=1h); assert r1.lease_expires_at == FormatUTC(created+5m); r2 = post(ttl=2m); assert r2.lease_expires_at == r2.expires_at

tests.title: The lease_expires_at migration is idempotent, leaves old rows NULL and tolerates a nil database
given: a sandbox_leases table created without the column and holding one row
tests.when: the migration runs twice, and once more on a nil *sql.DB
then: both runs return nil
PRAGMA table_info lists lease_expires_at exactly once
the pre-existing row reads lease_expires_at NULL
the nil database call returns nil without panicking
tests.pseudocode: assert Migrate(db) == nil; assert Migrate(db) == nil; assert count(pragma, 'lease_expires_at') == 1; assert select(lease_expires_at) IS NULL; assert Migrate(nil) == nil

tests.title: Every lease representation carries lease_expires_at as an RFC 3339 string or null
given: one lease issued with a deadline and one legacy row with NULL lease_expires_at
tests.when: the POST 201 body, GET one, the workspace list, the all=true list and the admin list are fetched
then: each lease object has the key lease_expires_at
the value is an RFC 3339 string for the new lease and JSON null for the legacy row
the exact-key-set assertion of spec 26 includes lease_expires_at
tests.pseudocode: for rep in [post, get_one, list, list_all, admin_list]: assert 'lease_expires_at' in rep; assert legacy.lease_expires_at is None; assert parse_rfc3339(new.lease_expires_at)

tests.title: lease_expires_at never changes after the lease is issued, whatever transitions are applied
given: a lease service, gateway backend, sweeper and shutdown over an in-memory database with an injected clock
tests.when: for any lease and any sequence of Create, DELETE, Close, clock advance, sweep, shutdown and restart recovery
then: the stored lease_expires_at equals the value written at issue after every step
tests.pseudocode: for ops in gen_op_sequences(): l = issue(); v0 = l.lease_expires_at; for op in ops: apply(op); assert read(l.id).lease_expires_at == v0

tests.title: The capacity count excludes leased leases whose lease_expires_at is at or before now, including exactly now
given: max_sandboxes = 1
one leased lease whose lease_expires_at is before now, and in a second case exactly equal to now
an injected clock
tests.when: a new lease is requested with POST
then: the POST answers 201 in both cases
with a leased lease whose lease_expires_at is one second in the future the POST is refused for capacity
tests.pseudocode: seed(leased, lease_expires_at=now); assert post().status == 201; reset(); seed(leased, lease_expires_at=now+1s); assert post().status == capacity_error

tests.title: A late Create is refused with FailedPrecondition naming expired, without a provider call, and expires the lease
given: a leased lease whose lease_expires_at is before the injected now and no sweep has run
a recording provider double
an in-process gatewayd server with hub's backend and a real gateway client
tests.when: the client sends Create with the lease token
then: the RPC fails with FailedPrecondition whose message contains "expired"
provider Create count is 0
GET of the lease reads state expired and end_reason expired
exactly one hub.sandbox.expire event with state expired is recorded
tests.pseudocode: clock.advance_past(lease_expires_at); err = client.Create(); assert code(err) == FailedPrecondition; assert 'expired' in msg; assert provider.creates == 0; assert get(id).state == 'expired'; assert count(events, 'hub.sandbox.expire') == 1

tests.title: The authenticator rejects the token of any lease whose expires_at has passed, in any state
given: leases in leased, active, destroyed-with-token and failed-with-token style rows whose expires_at is at or before now but whose token hashes are still stored
tests.when: an RPC is sent with each lease's token
then: every RPC fails with gRPC Unauthenticated
tests.pseudocode: for state in [leased, active, expired, failed]: seed(state, expires_at=now, keep_token=True); assert code(rpc(token)) == Unauthenticated

tests.title: After the expiry path ends a lease its token fails with Unauthenticated
given: a leased lease with a valid token that has been ended through the expiry path by a sweep
tests.when: a Create and then a second RPC are sent with that token
then: both RPCs fail with Unauthenticated
the lease's token_hash column is NULL
tests.pseudocode: sweep(); assert code(client.Create()) == Unauthenticated; assert code(client.Close()) == Unauthenticated; assert token_hash(id) is NULL

tests.title: A lease that leaves leased while its box is being created has the box destroyed and keeps its terminal state
given: a provider double whose Create blocks until released
a leased lease with a valid token
tests.when: Create is in flight, the lease is deleted (and in a second run expired by a sweep), then the provider Create is released
then: the Create RPC fails with FailedPrecondition naming the lease's current state
provider Destroy is called once with the new box's ID
the lease keeps its state and end_reason from the earlier ending
afhub_sandbox_creates_total{result=failed} increased by 1
tests.pseudocode: start create in goroutine; wait provider.entered; delete(lease); provider.release(); err = join(); assert code(err) == FailedPrecondition; assert provider.destroyed == [box.id]; assert get(id).end_reason == 'api'

tests.title: A late Create and a sweep racing on the same lapsed lease end it exactly once
given: a leased lease past its lease_expires_at
tests.when: for any interleaving and ordering of one late Create and one or more sweeps run concurrently
then: exactly one hub.sandbox.expire event exists for the lease
the lease changed state to expired exactly once
tests.pseudocode: for schedule in gen_schedules(): setup(); run_concurrently(create, sweep, sweep, order=schedule); assert count(events, id) == 1; assert get(id).state == 'expired'

tests.title: A sweep runs Reap before List and prunes and recalibrates after the endings
given: a recording provider double logging every call in order
an active overdue lease, a lapsed leased lease, an old terminal lease and a gauge value that disagrees with the table
tests.when: one sweep runs with the injected clock
then: Reap is recorded before List
the endings and Destroy calls occur before the old lease row is deleted
the gauge equals the table's active count when the sweep returns
tests.pseudocode: sweep(); assert idx(calls,'Reap') < idx(calls,'List'); assert row_deleted_after_endings; assert gauge('ws') == count(active)

tests.title: A failing sweep step is logged and every later step still runs
given: a provider whose Reap and List both return errors
an overdue active lease, a lapsed leased lease and an old terminal lease
a captured slog handler
tests.when: one sweep runs
then: the sweep function returns after all six steps
the lapsed lease reads expired
the overdue lease reads destroyed
the old terminal row is deleted
the gauge is recalibrated
two error records are logged
tests.pseudocode: provider.reap_err = E; provider.list_err = E; sweep(); assert get(leased).state == 'expired'; assert get(old) is None; assert len(error_logs) >= 2

tests.title: A sweep lapses a leased lease past lease_expires_at, or past expires_at when the column is NULL, without calling the provider
given: one leased lease with lease_expires_at before now
one legacy leased lease with NULL lease_expires_at and expires_at before now
one leased lease with a future deadline
tests.when: one sweep runs
then: the first two leases read expired with end_reason expired
the third lease stays leased
one hub.sandbox.expire event with state expired per lapsed lease
provider Destroy count is 0
the lapsed tokens fail with Unauthenticated
tests.pseudocode: sweep(); assert get(a).state == 'expired' and get(b).state == 'expired'; assert get(c).state == 'leased'; assert provider.destroys == 0; assert count(expire_events) == 2

tests.title: A sweep destroys the box of an active lease past expires_at and ends it as destroyed with end_reason expired
given: an active lease with a real box in the provider double (or AgentKit local)
the clock advanced past expires_at
tests.when: one sweep runs
then: provider List no longer contains the box
the lease reads destroyed with end_reason expired
exactly one hub.sandbox.expire event with state destroyed and the sandbox_id
no hub.sandbox.destroy event is recorded
tests.pseudocode: sweep(); assert box.id not in provider.List(); l = get(id); assert l.state == 'destroyed' and l.end_reason == 'expired'; assert events == [expire(state=destroyed, sandbox_id=box.id)]

tests.title: A failing Destroy still ends an overdue active lease and revokes its token, logging the scrubbed error
given: an overdue active lease
a provider whose Destroy returns an error containing https://user:pw@host/x
a captured slog handler
tests.when: one sweep runs
then: the lease reads destroyed with end_reason expired
its token fails with Unauthenticated
one log record carries lease_id, sandbox_id and the error text without the userinfo "user:pw"
tests.pseudocode: provider.destroy_err = Err('GET https://user:pw@host/x failed'); sweep(); assert get(id).state == 'destroyed'; r = find_log(lease_id=id); assert r.sandbox_id == sid; assert 'user:pw' not in r.error

tests.title: The orphan step destroys exactly the boxes matched to a terminal lease and no others
given: a provider listing boxes: B1 whose ID equals the sandbox_id of a destroyed lease, B2 whose hub.lease label names an expired lease, B3 belonging to an active lease, B4 with no hub.lease label, B5 labelled with a lease ID unknown to this hub
a second run where the listing exposes no labels
tests.when: one sweep runs
then: Destroy is called exactly for B1 and B2 in the labelled run
Destroy is called for B1 only in the label-less run
Destroy is never called for B3, B4 or B5
tests.pseudocode: sweep(); assert set(provider.destroyed) == {B1, B2}; assert B3 not in destroyed and B4 not in destroyed and B5 not in destroyed

tests.title: Concurrent sweep requests are serialised and no lease receives a second ending event
given: a provider double whose Reap blocks briefly and records the concurrent in-flight count
overdue leases
tests.when: ten goroutines call the sweep at once
then: the maximum observed concurrent sweeps is 1
each overdue lease has exactly one ending event
a lease ended by another path before the sweep reaches it emits no event
tests.pseudocode: parallel(10, sweep); assert provider.max_inflight_reap == 1; for l in leases: assert count(events, l.id) == 1

tests.title: A provider call that hangs is cancelled at the per-call limit and the sweep continues
given: the per-call limit configured to 50ms
a provider whose Reap, List and one Destroy block until their context is cancelled
a lapsed leased lease, an overdue active lease and an old terminal lease
tests.when: one sweep runs
then: the sweep returns in well under the sum of several seconds
a timeout is logged for each hung call
the lapsed lease reads expired
the old terminal row is deleted
tests.pseudocode: cfg.callTimeout = 50ms; t0 = now(); sweep(); assert now()-t0 < 2s; assert get(leased).state == 'expired'; assert get(old) is None

tests.title: Restart recovery destroys the box of every active lease and ends it as destroyed with end_reason restart
given: two active leases and one leased lease left by an earlier process
an audit emitter recording events
a gateway listener that records when it begins accepting
tests.when: the start-up sequence runs
then: provider Destroy is called for both boxes
both leases read destroyed with end_reason restart before the listener accepts
one hub.sandbox.destroy event per lease with reason restart, ActorType system and empty ActorID
the leased lease is unchanged
tests.pseudocode: startup(); assert all(get(l).end_reason == 'restart' for l in active); assert recovery_done_at < listener_accept_at; for e in events: assert e.metadata.reason == 'restart' and e.actor_type == 'system' and e.actor_id == ''

tests.title: A Destroy failure during restart recovery still ends the lease and a later sweep retries the box
given: an active lease whose provider Destroy fails once and whose box still exists
a captured slog handler
tests.when: restart recovery runs and then a sweep runs
then: the lease reads destroyed with end_reason restart
start-up proceeds
the logged error text is scrubbed
the sweep's orphan step calls Destroy for the box again
tests.pseudocode: provider.destroy_err_once = Err; recovery(); assert get(id).state == 'destroyed'; sweep(); assert provider.destroy_calls[box.id] == 2

tests.title: After recovery one sweep runs, then one per tick, and none after the reaper context is cancelled
given: an injected ticker factory
a counting sweep observed through provider Reap
tests.when: the reaper is started, three ticks are fired, the context is cancelled and a fourth tick is fired
then: Reap count is 1 after start (initial sweep)
Reap count is 4 after three ticks
Reap count stays 4 after cancellation and the loop goroutine has exited
tests.pseudocode: r = StartReaper(ctx, tickers); assert reaps == 1; for i in 3: tick(); wait(); assert reaps == 4; cancel(); join(r); tick(); assert reaps == 4

tests.title: Errors from recovery or the first sweep are returned and logged and never terminate the process
given: a provider whose Destroy, Reap and List all fail
tests.when: the start-up routine runs
then: it returns (and logs) the error instead of exiting
the caller continues and the reaper loop is still running
the test process is not terminated
tests.pseudocode: err = RunStartup(); assert err is not None; assert logged(err); assert reaper.running()

tests.title: Backend Reap runs the sweep only when the context carries no lease principal
given: hub's backend with a counting sweep and a recording provider
tests.when: Reap is called with a plain context and then with a context carrying a lease principal
then: both calls return nil
the sweep count is 1 after both calls
the principal call made no provider call
tests.pseudocode: assert backend.Reap(ctx) == nil; assert sweeps == 1; assert backend.Reap(withPrincipal(ctx,'L1')) == nil; assert sweeps == 1; assert provider.calls_after == provider.calls_before

tests.title: With the feature disabled no recovery, sweep or reaper runs and the lease table is untouched
given: a database holding active, leased and old terminal rows
a configuration with no [sandbox] section
tests.when: hub's start-up wiring runs and time passes past several reap intervals
then: the lease table is identical before and after
no provider call is made
tests.pseudocode: before = dump(leases); wire(disabled); tick_many(); assert dump(leases) == before

tests.title: A terminal lease that ended 24 hours or less ago stays readable, including after a sweep
given: terminal leases ended 23h ago, exactly 24h ago, and one with NULL ended_at whose updated_at is 23h ago
tests.when: a sweep runs and then GET one, GET ?all=true and the admin list are called
then: GET one answers 200 for each
the all=true and admin lists contain each
tests.pseudocode: sweep(); for l in leases: assert get(l.id).status == 200; assert l.id in list_all and l.id in admin_list

tests.title: A sweep deletes a terminal lease that ended more than 24 hours ago
given: a destroyed, an expired and a failed lease each ended 24h plus 1s ago, and one with NULL ended_at whose updated_at is 25h ago
tests.when: one sweep runs
then: GET one answers 404 for each
neither the all=true list nor the admin list contains them
tests.pseudocode: sweep(); for l in old: assert get(l.id).status == 404; assert l.id not in list_all

tests.title: A sweep never deletes a lease in leased or active state, whatever its age
given: a lease table with leases of random states and ages
tests.when: for any lease in leased or active state with any created_at, expires_at and updated_at, a sweep runs
then: the row still exists afterwards (it may have changed to a terminal state)
tests.pseudocode: for rows in gen_rows(states=[leased, active], age=any): seed(rows); sweep(); for r in rows: assert exists(r.id)

tests.title: The sandbox shutdown runs after Start returns and before the databases close, within 20 seconds
given: hub's main wiring with a fake server whose Start returns immediately
audit and SQLite handles that record when they are closed
tests.when: Start returns and the shutdown sequence runs
then: the sandbox shutdown is invoked before audit database Close and SQLite Close
both databases answer queries while shutdown runs
the shutdown limit is 20 seconds
tests.pseudocode: run_main(fake_server); assert order == ['shutdown_start','shutdown_end','auditDB.Close','database.Close']; assert shutdown_limit == 20s

tests.title: In shutdown mode Create fails with Unavailable and every ending carries end_reason shutdown
given: a leased lease and an active lease
hub in shutdown mode
tests.when: a Create is sent for the leased lease and the active lease is closed through DELETE
then: Create fails with gRPC Unavailable
provider Create count is unchanged
the lease ended in this mode reads end_reason shutdown
tests.pseudocode: EnterShutdown(); assert code(client.Create()) == Unavailable; assert provider.creates == 0; delete(active); assert get(active).end_reason == 'shutdown'

tests.title: Shutdown stops the reaper, destroys every active box, ends each lease as shutdown and stops the gateway
given: a running reaper
three active leases
a gateway server double recording its stop
tests.when: the sandbox shutdown runs
then: each active lease reads destroyed with end_reason shutdown
provider Destroy was called for each box
one hub.sandbox.destroy event per lease with reason shutdown, ActorType system and empty ActorID
no sweep starts after shutdown begins
the gateway stop was called after the leases ended
tests.pseudocode: Shutdown(ctx); for l in active: assert get(l).end_reason == 'shutdown'; assert reaper.stopped; assert gateway.stop_at > last_end_at; tick(); assert sweeps_after == sweeps_at_start

tests.title: Shutdown leaves every leased lease byte-identical
given: a lease table with random leased rows beside active rows
tests.when: for any set of leased leases, the sandbox shutdown runs
then: each leased row, including token_hash and deadline columns, is identical before and after
tests.pseudocode: for rows in gen_leased_rows(): before = dump(rows); Shutdown(ctx); assert dump(rows) == before

tests.title: Shutdown returns at its limit when Destroy hangs and leaves unfinished leases active
given: the shutdown limit configured to 100ms
a provider whose Destroy blocks forever for one lease's box and succeeds for another
tests.when: the sandbox shutdown runs
then: it returns within the limit plus a small margin
the lease whose Destroy hung reads active
the lease whose Destroy succeeded reads destroyed with end_reason shutdown
tests.pseudocode: limit = 100ms; t0 = now(); Shutdown(); assert now()-t0 < 1s; assert get(hung).state == 'active'; assert get(ok).state == 'destroyed'

tests.title: A second shutdown call, or shutdown with the feature disabled, does nothing
given: a completed shutdown with a recording provider
a disabled-feature sandbox handle
tests.when: shutdown is called a second time and on the disabled handle
then: both return nil
provider call counts are unchanged
the lease table is unchanged
tests.pseudocode: Shutdown(); n = provider.calls; snap = dump(); assert Shutdown() == nil; assert provider.calls == n; assert dump() == snap; assert disabled.Shutdown() == nil

tests.title: EventSandboxExpire has the value hub.sandbox.expire
tests.when: audit.EventSandboxExpire is read
then: it equals "hub.sandbox.expire"
tests.pseudocode: assert audit.EventSandboxExpire == 'hub.sandbox.expire'

tests.title: The expiry path emits one hub.sandbox.expire event with the specified fields
given: a recording emitter
a leased lease and an active lease with a box
tests.when: each is ended through the expiry path
then: each event has ResourceType sandbox, ResourceID the lease ID, Action expire, ActorType system, empty ActorID and Workspace the slug
metadata has lease_id and state expired for the leased lease
metadata has lease_id, state destroyed and sandbox_id for the active lease
the leased lease's metadata has no sandbox_id key
tests.pseudocode: e1 = expire(leased); assert e1.metadata == {lease_id, state:'expired'}; e2 = expire(active); assert e2.metadata == {lease_id, state:'destroyed', sandbox_id}

tests.title: Each ending emits exactly one of hub.sandbox.expire or hub.sandbox.destroy according to its cause
given: leases ended by a late Create, a sweep, shutdown and restart recovery
tests.when: each ending completes
then: late Create and sweep endings emit one expire event and no destroy event
shutdown and restart endings emit one destroy event with reason shutdown or restart and ActorType system and no expire event
tests.pseudocode: for cause in [late_create, sweep_lapse, sweep_overdue, shutdown, restart]: ev = events_for(lease); assert len(ev) == 1; assert ev[0].type == expected[cause]

tests.title: An ending that loses the conditional update emits no event and records no metric
given: an active lease that DELETE ended just before the sweep reaches it, the sweep holding a stale snapshot
gauge and histogram values recorded before the attempt
tests.when: the sweep's ending attempt for that lease affects no row
then: the event count is unchanged by the attempt
afhub_sandboxes_active is not decremented a second time
the lease histogram sample count is unchanged
tests.pseudocode: snapshot = list_overdue(); delete(l); events0 = count(); g0 = gauge(); hist0 = hist_count(); sweep_with(snapshot); assert count() == events0; assert gauge() == g0; assert hist_count() == hist0

tests.title: A nil emitter or a failing Emit does not prevent or alter the ending
given: a lapsed leased lease in each of three setups: working emitter, nil emitter, emitter returning an error
a captured slog handler
tests.when: the expiry path ends the lease
then: the lease reads expired in all three
the returned result is the same in all three
the failing emitter produces one slog.Error record
the nil emitter produces no panic
tests.pseudocode: for em in [ok, nil, failing]: r = expire(lease, em); assert r == baseline; assert get(id).state == 'expired'

tests.title: No event, log record or lease field written by the expiry flows contains a secret, env value, token or token hash
given: leases created with random secret values, env values and tokens
captured events, slog output and database rows
a provider whose Destroy errors embed URL userinfo
tests.when: for any lease, run late Create, sweeps, restart recovery and shutdown
then: no captured event, log record or lease row contains any injected secret, env value, token or token hash
logged provider error text has URL userinfo removed
tests.pseudocode: for l in gen_leases_with_secrets(): run_all_flows(l); blob = events + logs + rows; for s in l.secrets + l.env_values + [l.token, l.token_hash]: assert s not in blob; assert not re.search('://[^/@]+@', logs)

tests.title: The three sandbox metrics are registered and listed on /metrics before any lease exists
given: a fresh audit.NewMetrics()
the /metrics handler
tests.when: GET /metrics is served
then: the body lists afhub_sandboxes_active, afhub_sandbox_creates_total and afhub_sandbox_lease_seconds
afhub_sandbox_creates_total has result="created" and result="failed" at 0
afhub_sandboxes_active has the placeholder workspace="" series
tests.pseudocode: body = get('/metrics'); for n in names: assert n in body; assert 'afhub_sandbox_creates_total{result="created"} 0' in body; assert 'le="28800"' in body

tests.title: afhub_sandboxes_active goes up on activation and down on an ending of an active lease
given: a lease in workspace ws
a Metrics instance
tests.when: the lease is activated by Create and then ended by DELETE
then: the ws gauge value is 1 after activation
the ws gauge value is 0 after the ending
tests.pseudocode: create(); assert gauge('ws') == 1; delete(); assert gauge('ws') == 0

tests.title: The active gauge is recalibrated from the table after restart recovery and at the end of every sweep
given: active leases in two workspaces
gauge values deliberately wrong, including a stale workspace label
tests.when: restart recovery finishes and, separately, a sweep completes
then: after each, the gauge has exactly one series per workspace with active rows set to the GROUP BY count
the stale label is gone
tests.pseudocode: gauge.set('stale', 9); sweep(); assert gauge_series() == {ws1: n1, ws2: n2}

tests.title: A Create accepted for a leased lease increments exactly one creates_total result series
given: leases for a successful create, a provider error, a missing required secret, and a lease deleted during box creation
tests.when: Create is sent for each
then: the first increments result=created by 1
the other three each increment result=failed by 1
the other series is unchanged in each case
tests.pseudocode: for scenario in [ok, provider_err, secret_missing, left_leased]: before = counters(); run(scenario); assert delta(counters()) == {expected[scenario]: 1}

tests.title: A Create refused before acceptance leaves afhub_sandbox_creates_total unchanged
given: an unknown token, an already active lease, a missed lease deadline and shutdown mode, one setup each
tests.when: Create is sent in each setup
then: each Create fails with its refusal code
both result series keep their values
tests.pseudocode: for scenario in [unknown_token, second_create, late, shutdown]: before = counters(); err = create(); assert err; assert counters() == before

tests.title: A lease that becomes destroyed observes ended_at minus created_at on afhub_sandbox_lease_seconds once
given: active leases destroyed by DELETE, by a sweep, by shutdown and by restart recovery
one lease that lapses to expired
tests.when: each ending completes
then: the histogram sample count increases by 1 for each destroyed lease and not for the expired one
the sum increases by each lease's ended_at − created_at in seconds

tests.title: A nil *audit.Metrics records nothing and the same results are produced
given: sandbox code constructed with a nil *audit.Metrics
tests.when: activation, endings and a sweep run
then: no panic occurs

tests.title: afhub_sandboxes_active equals the per-workspace count of active leases after every step
given: a lease service, gateway backend and sweeper over several workspaces with an injected clock
tests.when: for any sequence of activations, endings, clock advances and sweeps run one at a time
then: after each step the gauge for every workspace equals the number of active rows in the table
tests.pseudocode: for ops in gen_ops(): for op in ops: apply(op); for ws in workspaces: assert gauge(ws) == count(active, ws)

tests.title: An unused lease lapses at its deadline, is expired by the reaper and its token stops working

an injected clock

then: POST returned 201 with lease_expires_at
GET reads state expired and end_reason expired

the token fails with Unauthenticated
